1、APPROVAL 节点返回的 ACCEPTED Continuation 现在带稳定 approval_id； 2、待审批请求进入 PlanExecutionState.pending_approvals； 3、新增 ExecutionEngine.resolve_approval(plan_id, decision) 和 HarnessApplication.resolve_approval(...)； 4、审批决定先持久化再 Resume；拒绝仍遵守普通 FailurePolicy 和 EdgeTrigger.DENIED，所以可以进入拒绝/补偿分支； 5、支持 SQLite 重启后在新 Engine 中完成审批；也处理了 WAITING checkpoint 与 ApprovalRequest 落盘之间崩溃的恢复窗口。

1、Capability 返回 ACCEPTED + Continuation.job_ref 后，节点进入 WAITING，API 立即返回，不长期占用 asyncio Task。 2、新增 AsyncWaitingCoordinator，将 Continuation 归一化为稳定的 plan_id + node_id + job_ref 并写入 pending_jobs。 3、新增 ExecutionEngine.complete_async_node(plan_id, node_id, terminal_result)。 4、新增 HarnessApplication.complete_async_node(...)。 completion 只允许 SUCCESS / PARTIAL / FAILED / DENIED / CANCELLED，再次传 ACCEPTED 会返回 HARNESS.ASYNC.RESULT_NOT_TERMINAL。 5、completion 先写 StateStore，再调用 Resume，因此原进程退出后仍可在新进程完成同一个 plan_id。 6、terminal result 继续使用 Scheduler 原有 _apply_node_result()，因此 FailurePolicy、SUCCESS/FAILED/DENIED Edge、PARTIAL 和下游 Binding 都不会出现第二套特殊语义。Scheduler 原本就把 ACCEPTED 映射为 WAITING + Continuation。 7、Provider 可以不填写 plan_id/node_id，Engine 自动补全；但 job_ref 必须存在，冲突的 Plan/Node 引用会 fail-closed。 支持 WAITING 已 checkpoint、但 pending_jobs 尚未来得及保存就崩溃的恢复窗口。 8、Resume Deadline 超时时同步清理 pending_jobs。 9、保存最小 async completion audit：node_id / job_ref / terminal status / completed_at。
补齐 PRE_PLAN + PRE_EXECUTE、REQUIRE_APPROVAL、稳定 Plan/Node Trace，以及最小 in-process Execution Event Model

1、End-to-End：验证 Stage 1 Direct Invocation 没被破坏；使用真实 finance.mock-query/v1 + math.calculate/v1 → Join → Approval → echo.reply/v1 跑 finance-review-plan；以及 Retry success + CONTINUE failure + Approval + SQLite restart + Resume → PARTIAL 的完整故障链路。说明书要求的确定性 finance-review-plan 和 restart 流程也覆盖到了。 2、Fault Injection：transient failure、retry exhausted、unsafe WRITE 不重试、timeout、运行前取消、运行中取消、provider exception、invalid provider result，以及额外的 checkpoint 写失败时 Provider 不得产生副作用。 3、Restart：RUNNING 的 READ 节点安全重放、非幂等 WRITE 返回 HARNESS.PLAN.RESUME_UNSAFE、Async WAITING 跨重启完成、损坏 SQLite snapshot 后 fail-closed。

Stage 3A: add provider contracts
- add ProviderDescriptor, ProviderHealthSnapshot and ProviderPin - add SelectionContext, SelectionDecision and SelectionRejection - add ProviderAttempt contract - extend ErrorDetail with fallbackable - add provider and selection error codes - export new contracts from harness_contracts - add provider contract validation tests

Stage 3A: support multi-provider registry
- upgrade capability registry from 1:1 to 1:N provider mapping - add ProviderRegistration and ProviderQuery - add register_provider, unregister_provider and candidates APIs - keep canonical CapabilityDescriptor per capability - preserve legacy resolve behavior for single-provider capabilities - adapt CapabilityCatalog to remain capability-only - update LocalPluginLoader to track and unload provider ids - allow different plugins to provide the same capability - reject incompatible provider capability contracts

Stage 3A: add provider selection and health foundation
- add harness-selection module - add ProviderSelector SPI and PrioritySelector - add EligibilityPipeline - add StaticHealthSource and TestHealthSource - support tenant, policy, health and provider-pin eligibility - add deterministic provider ordering - reject unhealthy and ineligible providers - fail closed on unsupported selection constraints - add selection and health unit tests

Stage 3A: integrate provider selection into capability invoker
- replace unique registry resolution with candidate selection - build SelectionContext for each invocation - execute only the selected provider - expose ProviderDescriptor to PRE_EXECUTE policy - keep RequestTarget.plugin as a provider candidate constraint - add provider identity to capability trace attributes - inject ProviderSelector through bootstrap - preserve Stage 1 and Stage 2 invocation compatibility - fail closed on invalid selector decisions
